backgrounds.name: The Back Seat of a Car

modifiers.text: Appears in a stranger's wedding photos
Appears in two places at once
Ate something at the park. Unclear what.
Barks at nothing for forty minutes
Has a better bed than you
Has a scar with a story
Is the reason for the no-dogs rule
Knows one trick and does it constantly
Never once had an accident indoors
Respects the UPS driver, hates the mailman
Stares at the wall for long periods
Vet says he's fine. He is not fine.
Waits by the door all day
